title: Murder
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the Dunder Mifflin office grapples with rumors of bankruptcy while Michael organizes a murder mystery dinner party game called Belles, Bourbon and Bullets. The game leads to playful conflicts and character role-playing, including Michael adopting a southern accent persona named Caleb Crawdad. Meanwhile, corporate issues escalate as Accounting is instructed to stop payments to vendors, signaling financial trouble. The episode culminates in a tense standoff among key characters, with Jim and Pam ultimately deciding to leave the office together.
